Baseline Padel's policy states that for children under the age of sixteen, including your 6-year-old, there must be clear supervision and responsibility defined between the parent or guardian and the club staff. The policy aims to ensure that there is no ambiguous period where no one is accountable for the child's whereabouts. This means you cannot leave your 6-year-old alone at the club without supervision while you play.

If you cancel a court booking two hours before the scheduled start time, it falls within the late cancellation window. According to Baseline Padel's Booking & Cancellation Policy, members may cancel free of charge only up to six hours before the start time. Cancellations made later than six hours before play, including two hours before, are subject to late cancellation terms, which may include fees or no refund. It is recommended to cancel as early as possible to allow others to book the court.
